oracle_policy: Every matrix case maps one-to-one to a literal outcome in the pinned decision-provenance packet. Test setup is fixed independently; candidate output never supplies expected values.

groups.setup: Use a fresh task-owned empty FalkorDB graph and render/query the operations docket before seeding.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: An empty graph is misrepresented as evidence that no decision or conflict exists, or leaks a hidden count/identifier.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The cold docket returns exactly zero decision rows.
The cold response uses unknown and no-evidence semantics.
No decision ID, title, or source is exposed.
No count, existence hint, or empty-state identifier is exposed.
The response does not conclude that no decision or conflict exists or is resolved.
No current owner or conflict-resolution conclusion is asserted.

groups.setup: Seed only the pinned register fixture, traverse from REGISTER-OPS-DECISIONS-01, and collect every source witness and timestamp in stable source order.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: A static status badge, disconnected record, property-only citation, claim-role substitution, or stale timestamp can imitate the baseline without the finite graph witness.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The root TRACKS edge reaches exactly DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01.
Exactly one docket record is returned.
The exact record title, open-unresolved state, statement, and decision-register Evidence node are returned.
The record source citation is supported by DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01 -[:EVIDENCED_BY]-> SRC-DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01.
The docket explicitly considers SOP-OPS-9-V2 and SOP-OPS-9-V3.
V2 claim, ROLE-FACILITIES-DUTY, source ID/title, 16:00Z time, and EVIDENCED_BY edge are exact.
V3 claim, ROLE-MATERIALS-LEAD, source ID/title, 16:04Z time, and EVIDENCED_BY edge are exact.
The exact V2-to-V3 SOP_CONFLICT edge remains unresolved.
Neither claim is promoted to current-owner fact; no version, procedure, contact, or action is selected.

groups.setup: On the owned seeded graph, remove only DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01 -[:CONSIDERS]-> SOP-OPS-9-V2; keep node properties, all source nodes/edges, remaining docket edges, and incident graph untouched.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: A surviving V3 claim is incorrectly promoted or the conflict is declared resolved when one considered-version edge is absent.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The sole mutation is the exact docket-to-V2 CONSIDERS relationship.
The docket witness becomes incomplete/unknown.
No complete two-claim provenance witness is returned.
V3 is not selected or promoted as authoritative.
The missing edge is not reported as a resolved or absent disagreement.
Both exact preexisting INC-204 impact paths remain unchanged.

groups.setup: On the owned seeded graph remove only DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01 -[:EVIDENCED_BY]-> SRC-DEC-OPS-9-REVIEW-01 while preserving decision/source nodes and all their properties.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: Stored record properties are mistaken for a provenance edge and disclose the record identity/state without its own evidence link.

pinned_assertions.assertion: Only the decision's own EVIDENCED_BY edge is removed.
The source node and decision ID/title/state properties remain in the graph.
The docket projection becomes generic unknown/no-evidence.
Decision ID, title, state, and record-source facts are suppressed.
Properties alone are not accepted as a citation or provenance witness.
The unrelated existing SOP-impact projection remains semantically unchanged.

groups.setup: On the owned seeded graph remove only SOP-OPS-9-V2 -[:EVIDENCED_BY]-> SRC-SOP-CURRENT-V2; retain all properties, source nodes, conflict edge, incident graph and V3 evidence.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: V2 is cited from properties, or the sole supported V3 branch is incorrectly treated as the winner.

pinned_assertions.assertion: Only the exact V2-to-source EVIDENCED_BY relationship is removed.
The V2 claim/source is not reconstructed from node properties.
The exact V3 claim, role, source ID/title/time, and evidence edge remain visible.
The docket state is incomplete/unknown.
The surviving V3 claim is not selected as a winner and the conflict stays unresolved.
The original two INC-204 paths remain exact and unchanged.
Existing SOP-impact may omit only the unsupported V2 claim, not alter incident paths or resolve conflict.

groups.setup: Add the fixed synthetic decoy component from test_setup_only without any path from REGISTER-OPS-DECISIONS-01, and query the same root-scoped docket.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: Global scans or lexical matches pull an untracked decision into the finite register result.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The decoy has no path from the register root through TRACKS.
No decoy decision, claim, or source appears in the docket rows.
The one-record baseline projection is semantically unchanged.

groups.setup: Record the complete operations API, visible count fields, rendered browser text and accessibility tree. Add the fixed connected restricted decision/claim/source fixture, then repeat those reads and compare semantically.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: Direct or derived disclosure leaks a restricted title/fact, existence/count signal, relationship, path, or paraphrase into API or accessible UI output.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The full operations API projection before and after injection is semantically identical.
All visible count fields are unchanged.
Browser text and the complete accessibility tree are semantically unchanged.
No restricted ID, title, or source body is disclosed.
No hidden count, existence, relationship, or graph path is disclosed.
No restricted fact or dependent paraphrase is disclosed.

groups.setup: Seed the unique owned graph, apply each task-owned adversarial edge removal, invoke the fixture loader twice, and inspect IDs, relationship multiplicity, source ordering and timestamps.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: Repeated fixture loading duplicates graph records/edges or fails to restore exact fixed provenance after a mutation.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The fixture loader runs twice against the same owned graph.
The second load creates zero duplicate fixed node IDs.
The second load creates zero duplicate fixed relationships.
Each owned mutation is restored to the exact one-record baseline.
All three evidence sources return in exact order with their original timestamps.

groups.setup: After seeding and read assertions, close the client, reconnect with a new FalkorDB client, compare the exact snapshot, exercise only read endpoints/browser reads, and run cleanup for the test-owned resources.
groups.attack_or_edge_case: A warm client masks lost evidence, read paths write state, or cleanup deletes/stops resources that the test does not own.

pinned_assertions.assertion: The final snapshot is read using a newly created client connection.
The fresh-client snapshot exactly matches the pinned baseline.
Read/query/browser paths add zero graph nodes and relationships.
Read/query/browser paths write no local action file or action record.
Cleanup deletes only this task's unique graph and state.
Cleanup stops only processes started by this task.
